Reference

Scope and documentation

ConstituF evaluates local constitutive material-point responses in modern Fortran. It provides batched fields, trial/committed history, optional algorithmic tangents and selected analytical parameter sensitivities. It is not a finite-element solver.

Choose a model in the materials catalog, then consult the conventions for tensor packing, units and derivative semantics. The public interface summarizes available operations.

For related procedures, consult checkpoint and restart, working precision and parameter calibration. The API reference is generated directly from the Fortran source.

Explore the annulus and spherical-cavity benchmarks or review the verification methods.
